title: Audit and remediate libraries causing unsafe warnings in modern Java
description:
Evaluate dependencies to identify libraries that trigger "unsafe" warnings or errors in modern Java versions. Create a remediation plan to update, replace, or remove problematic libraries.

Context: Modern Java versions are increasingly strict about unsafe operations, internal API access, and reflective access. Libraries using deprecated or unsafe APIs may cause warnings or failures.

Goals:
- Identify all dependencies that cause unsafe warnings
- Research available updates or alternatives
- Prioritize by severity and impact
- Create sub-tasks for each library that needs action
- Ensure application remains stable during migrations

This epic will likely spawn multiple sub-tasks for individual library updates/replacements.

title: Remediate Lombok unsafe API usage
description:
Lombok is using terminally deprecated sun.misc.Unsafe::objectFieldOffset which will be removed in future Java releases.

Current warning:
```
WARNING: sun.misc.Unsafe::objectFieldOffset has been called by lombok.permit.Permit
WARNING: sun.misc.Unsafe::objectFieldOffset will be removed in a future release
```

Affected code: All classes using Lombok annotations (@Data, @Getter, @Setter, etc.)

Remediation options:
1. Upgrade Lombok to latest version that avoids deprecated APIs
2. Replace Lombok with Java records (for simple data classes)
3. Generate getters/setters manually or use IDE generation

See LIBRARY-AUDIT.md for full details.

title: Remediate Mockito/Byte Buddy dynamic agent loading
description:
Mockito is dynamically loading Byte Buddy agent which will be disallowed by default in future JDK releases.

Current warning:
```
WARNING: A Java agent has been loaded dynamically (byte-buddy-agent-1.17.8.jar)
WARNING: Dynamic loading of agents will be disallowed by default in a future release
Mockito is currently self-attaching to enable the inline-mock-maker.
```

Affected code: All unit tests using Mockito

Remediation options:
1. Add JVM flag: -XX:+EnableDynamicAgentLoading (workaround)
2. Configure Mockito as a static agent in test execution
3. Upgrade to latest Mockito version with better Java 21+ support
4. Switch to alternative mocking framework

See LIBRARY-AUDIT.md for full details.

title: Remediate SQLite JDBC restricted native access
description:
SQLite JDBC is using restricted System::load for native library loading, which will be blocked in future releases.

Current warning:
```
WARNING: java.lang.System::load has been called by org.sqlite.SQLiteJDBCLoader
WARNING: Restricted methods will be blocked in a future release unless native access is enabled
```

Affected code: All database operations

Remediation options:
1. Add JVM flag: --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED (workaround)
2. Upgrade to latest sqlite-jdbc version with proper native access handling
3. Switch to H2 database (pure Java, no native code)
4. Package as module with explicit native access permissions

See LIBRARY-AUDIT.md for full details.
